pages.title: Home
pages.content:
## Every child deserves to read.

Urban Hope NYC is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit rooted in Staten Island's North Shore. We work alongside children, families, and schools to close the literacy gap — one reader at a time.

### What We Do

We deliver structured, evidence-based literacy programming to under-resourced students in our community. Our work is grounded in the science of reading, built on relationships, and measured by real outcomes.

### Our Community

The North Shore of Staten Island is one of New York City's most diverse and underserved corridors. We show up here — not as outsiders, but as neighbors.

---

*Urban Hope NYC is a registered 501(c)(3) organization. Donations are tax-deductible to the fullest extent of the law.*
